description: A linear progress / gauge on a fixed scale, with an optional target marker. The fill width and marker position are the only dynamic inline styles. Copy: the label carries the sentence, because a gauge with a number and no subject is a decoration: "Storage used, 62 of 100 GB".

props.name: target
props.description: Optional goal marker rendered on the track.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Tick labels under the track: an explicit list, or `true` for [0, max].

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description of what the meter measures.

example: <Meter value={1.4} max={3} target={2} tone="warning" ticks={[0, 1, 2, 3]} label="Maturity 1.4 of 3" />
